description: PER-FILE type-error baseline for libs/papercusp/packages/orchestrator (mirrors packages/operator-core/.tsc-baseline.json and apps/operator-vite/.tsc-baseline.json, P-010/WI-4535/EI-847). A file whose current error count exceeds its baseline here is a NEW, ATTRIBUTED regression and gates lint:tsc:orchestrator (the gate NAMES the file).
note: 2026-08-02 (WI-6826): seeded from a fresh `tsc -p libs/papercusp/packages/orchestrator/tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false` snapshot, the FIRST time these 157 sources were ever typechecked (no tsconfig existed, so build:typecheck refused the package with project_not_found and lint:tsc covers only packages/operator-core). Every entry below is a TEST file: the 2 errors the run found in production source (readonly-array variance at both parseBlueprintLocalRoots call sites in src/invoke.ts) were FIXED in the same change rather than baselined, so orchestrator's src/ is at a strict ZERO and this file records test-fixture debt only. Do NOT read an entry as acceptable — read it as owed. The debt is stale fixtures that drifted while nothing typechecked them: types they construct gained required fields (BuildPromptInput wants promptOverride/cwdOverride/featureId), helper arity changed (`Expected 1 arguments, but got 2`), and blueprint.spine.edges became optional (TS18048). ⚠ Some of these are BYTE-STABILITY tests (bee-preamble, prompt-build) that pass extra arguments the signature no longer accepts — a green run there may be asserting against a call the implementation never receives, so treat those two files as suspected silent no-ops until re-verified, not merely as type noise (tracked separately from WI-6826).
